# King of the Hill from ASSS 1.4.4 src/core/koth.c (compiled unmodified).
# state <tag> then one field per player:
#   <index>:[spec,]<crown>/<hadcrown>/<deaths>/<crownkills>/<flag>
#   crown is 1 while the player holds a crown. hadcrown is who held one as of the
#   last check_koth (or game start) and decides who wins. deaths counts deaths
#   suffered WITH a crown. crownkills counts kills of crowned players made without
#   one. flag is the F_HAS_CROWN bit in the player's own packet data, which is what
#   other clients see.
# kill <killer> <killed> ran the CB_KILL handler for that pair.
# start / check ran start_koth() / check_koth(); ASSS's arena timer calls check_koth.
# Rules these records pin:
#   start_koth crowns every non-spec player and clears their counters; spectators get
#     no crown and have hadcrown cleared too.
#   A crowned victim loses the crown only once deaths EXCEED King:DeathCount, so
#     DeathCount 0 means the first death takes it.
#   A crowned killer has their timer reset to the full ExpireTime. No recorded state
#     changes, which is why those records look unchanged.
#   An uncrowned killer who kills a CROWNED player counts a crownkill, and on reaching
#     King:CrownRecoverKills gets a crown back with deaths and crownkills both reset.
#   But a kill that REMOVES the victim's last crown does NOT count as a crownkill:
#     ASSS re-tests the victim's crown after removing it, so with DeathCount 0 the
#     CrownRecoverKills path is unreachable. Compare the two cases below.
#   check_koth awards only when NO crowns are left. The winners are everyone whose
#     hadcrown was set at the previous check; without a points-koth module each gets
#     1000/winners points (integer division). A new game starts straight away if at
#     least MinPlaying players are in ships. check_koth finally copies crown into
#     hadcrown for every non-spec player.
# start, 4 in ships + 2 spec: ExpireTime 18000 DeathCount 0 CrownRecoverKills 0 MinPlaying 3, 6 players (ship bitmap 0xf)
start
state after_start 0:1/1/0/0/flag 1:1/1/0/0/flag 2:1/1/0/0/flag 3:1/1/0/0/flag 4:spec,0/0/0/0/- 5:spec,0/0/0/0/-
# DeathCount 0: ExpireTime 18000 DeathCount 0 CrownRecoverKills 0 MinPlaying 3, 4 players (ship bitmap 0xf)
start
kill 0 1
state after_kill 0:1/1/0/0/flag 1:0/1/1/0/- 2:1/1/0/0/flag 3:1/1/0/0/flag
# DeathCount 2: ExpireTime 18000 DeathCount 2 CrownRecoverKills 0 MinPlaying 3, 4 players (ship bitmap 0xf)
start
kill 0 1
state after_kill 0:1/1/0/0/flag 1:1/1/1/0/flag 2:1/1/0/0/flag 3:1/1/0/0/flag
kill 0 1
state after_kill 0:1/1/0/0/flag 1:1/1/2/0/flag 2:1/1/0/0/flag 3:1/1/0/0/flag
kill 0 1
state after_kill 0:1/1/0/0/flag 1:0/1/3/0/- 2:1/1/0/0/flag 3:1/1/0/0/flag
kill 0 1
state after_kill 0:1/1/0/0/flag 1:0/1/3/0/- 2:1/1/0/0/flag 3:1/1/0/0/flag
# CrownRecoverKills 3, DeathCount 0 (recovery unreachable): ExpireTime 18000 DeathCount 0 CrownRecoverKills 3 MinPlaying 3, 4 players (ship bitmap 0xf)
start
kill 0 1
state after_kill 0:1/1/0/0/flag 1:0/1/1/0/- 2:1/1/0/0/flag 3:1/1/0/0/flag
kill 1 2
state after_kill 0:1/1/0/0/flag 1:0/1/1/0/- 2:0/1/1/0/- 3:1/1/0/0/flag
kill 1 2
state after_kill 0:1/1/0/0/flag 1:0/1/1/0/- 2:0/1/1/0/- 3:1/1/0/0/flag
kill 1 2
state after_kill 0:1/1/0/0/flag 1:0/1/1/0/- 2:0/1/1/0/- 3:1/1/0/0/flag
kill 1 2
state after_kill 0:1/1/0/0/flag 1:0/1/1/0/- 2:0/1/1/0/- 3:1/1/0/0/flag
# CrownRecoverKills 2, DeathCount 2 (recovery works): ExpireTime 18000 DeathCount 2 CrownRecoverKills 2 MinPlaying 3, 4 players (ship bitmap 0xf)
start
kill 0 1
kill 0 1
kill 0 1
state one_uncrowned 0:1/1/0/0/flag 1:0/1/3/0/- 2:1/1/0/0/flag 3:1/1/0/0/flag
kill 1 2
state after_kill 0:1/1/0/0/flag 1:0/1/3/1/- 2:1/1/1/0/flag 3:1/1/0/0/flag
kill 1 2
state after_kill 0:1/1/0/0/flag 1:1/1/0/0/flag 2:1/1/2/0/flag 3:1/1/0/0/flag
kill 1 2
state after_kill 0:1/1/0/0/flag 1:1/1/0/0/flag 2:0/1/3/0/- 3:1/1/0/0/flag
# CrownRecoverKills 0: ExpireTime 18000 DeathCount 2 CrownRecoverKills 0 MinPlaying 3, 4 players (ship bitmap 0xf)
start

# check_koth, all crowned: ExpireTime 18000 DeathCount 0 CrownRecoverKills 0 MinPlaying 3, 4 players (ship bitmap 0xf)
